text_description: Cropped runway view focused from mid-torso to shoes, showing a fluid asymmetrical wrap-style skirt in warm beige with a scarf-like border print. The skirt sits around the natural waist/upper hip and drapes diagonally across the front, creating overlapping panels, soft folds, and a high front slit that exposes one leg while the hem falls in uneven handkerchief points toward the ankles. The print features broad pale blue bands with narrow black, white, and deep burgundy stripes running along the edges and across the body, giving the piece a graphic silk-scarf effect; small tassel-like ends are visible near the lower points. Styling includes chunky gold bracelets on both wrists and black-and-white high-heeled ankle-strap shoes with a rounded light toe panel and dark bow-like detail at the front. The overall look is polished, resort-like, and movement-focused, combining a close upper silhouette with a fluid draped printed skirt and refined heels.
